Ravi P.: Hi team, accepted the org invite but when I try to clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra.git I get permission denied (publickey). 2FA is enabled. Any quick checks?

Jordan (DevEx): Welcome! Most likely your local SSH key isn't added to the GH account that has org access. Quick check: ssh -T git@github.com — what does it print?

Ravi P.: It says: Permission denied (publickey). I have an id_rsa in ~/.ssh but not sure which account it's tied to.

Nora (IT): If ssh -T fails, try: ssh -vT git@github.com to see which key is offered. Also ensure your work key is uploaded to the GitHub account that accepted the invite. We can re-send the invite to a different GH handle if needed.

Ravi P.: Ran ssh -vT, shows it's trying id_ed25519_personal. I accepted invite with my work account ravi@redwood.email, but my laptop uses ravi-personal.

Jordan (DevEx): Two options: add your work key to the work account and update ~/.ssh/config to use it for github.com, or we can add your personal GH account to the org. Policy prefers using the work identity. Example ~/.ssh/config entry:
```
Host github.com
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
```

onboarding-bot: Note: invite pending for ravi-personal (auto-check 11:12am).

Ravi P.: I'll add the work key and switch config. One question: do I need to authorize SSO after accepting?

Nora (IT): Yes — if the org enforces SAML, after you accept you must authorize SSO on the account. Visit https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso while signed into the work account and click Authorize. Without that, private repo access is blocked.

Ravi P.: Added key, updated ssh config, ssh -T now says "Hi ravi-redwood! You've successfully authenticated." Authorized SSO too. I can clone now. Thanks!

Jordan (DevEx): Awesome, welcome aboard :tada: If you want, drop your GH handle in the welcome doc and we'll add you to the infra-team with repo perms.

Ravi P.: Done — GH handle is ravi-redwood. Appreciate the help!
